note: Maybank's credit card fees and charges: the Maybank Visa Classic's principal card costs 60 ringgit a year; finance charges are 15%, 17% or 18% a year by the holder's record of prompt repayment over the last twelve months, written at the top. The 25-ringgit service tax per card isn't written, the page not saying how often it falls.

sources.title: Maybank, Credit Card: Banking Fees
sources.said: Maybank Visa Classic Principal: RM60 Supplementary: RM30 ... For prompt repayment of 12/12 months 1.25% 15% For prompt repayment of 10/12 months 1.42% 17% For Prompt repayment of less than 10/12 months 1.50% 18% ... Service Tax Principal Card: RM25 per Card
